# FORMAL NOTICE OF WRONGFUL TERMINATION & CEASE AND DESIST

**To:** TechCorp GmbH, Legal Department  
**From:** Dr. Ava Patel, Attorney at Law  
**Date:** August 12, 2026  
**Re:** Extraordinary Termination of Ms. Elena Rostova  

Dear Sirs/Madams,

We represent Ms. Elena Rostova regarding the extraordinary termination letter dated August 4, 2026.

Under Section 4 of the German Dismissal Protection Act (KSchG), an extraordinary termination requires extraordinary cause under BGB § 626. The alleged remote work policy violation does not constitute sufficient grounds for summary dismissal without prior formal warning (Abmahnung).

We demand immediate reinstatement and written confirmation of continued salary payments by August 25, 2026. Failing this, a protection lawsuit will be filed with the Labor Court.

Sincerely,  
Dr. Ava Patel
